title: Preserve a draft when authentication is required
description: A visitor can submit a completed report draft and be sent to sign in while the draft remains available for continuation afterward.
category: Preparation and draft preservation of a noise report

steps.description: Navigate to /reportar
Fill in the place search field with a Huancayo location
Select a suggested place
Select a noise source
Fill in the report description field with a brief observation
Submit the report
Verify the user is redirected to the login page
Verify the report draft is still available after authentication is required

title: Inspect a hotspot from the home map
description: A visitor can open the home map, select a hotspot, and view its detail popup with hotspot information.
category: Exploration of the map and critical noise points

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a hotspot marker on the map
Verify a hotspot details popup is displayed
Verify decibel information and a hotspot description are displayed

title: Prepare a report with place search and microphone level
description: A visitor can search for a Huancayo location, select a suggestion, choose a noise source, enter observations, and capture microphone-level information in a report draft.
category: Preparation and draft preservation of a noise report

steps.description: Navigate to /reportar
Fill in the place search field with a Huancayo location
Select a suggested place
Select a noise source
Fill in the report description field with a brief observation
Capture or enable the relative microphone level
Verify the report draft contains the selected place, noise source, description, and microphone level information

title: Compare hotspot details from the dedicated list
description: A visitor can open the hotspot list page, select an entry, and review the associated hotspot details and reference information.
category: Exploration of the map and critical noise points

steps.description: Navigate to /puntos-criticos
Click a hotspot entry in the list
Verify hotspot details are displayed
Verify reference information for the selected hotspot is displayed

title: Register a citizen with matching Junín territory selections
description: A visitor can complete the citizen registration form with valid personal data and a consistent Junín department, province, and district selection.

steps.description: Navigate to /registro
Fill in the names field with a first name
Fill in the surnames field with a last name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the address field with a valid address
Select the Junín department
Select a province within Junín
Select a district within the selected province
Fill in the username field with a new username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Complete the registration
Verify the account is created successfully
Verify the authenticated session state is shown in the interface

title: Reject mismatched territorial selections during registration
description: A visitor sees validation feedback and stays on the registration form when the chosen department, province, and district do not match.

steps.description: Navigate to /registro
Fill in the names field with a first name
Fill in the surnames field with a last name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the address field with a valid address
Select the Junín department
Select a province within Junín
Select a district from a different territory
Fill in the username field with a new username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Complete the registration
Verify a territorial validation error is displayed
Verify the registration form remains available

title: Read the privacy policy
description: A visitor can review how report data, account data, microphone access, and map usage are handled on the privacy page.

steps.description: Navigate to /privacidad
Verify privacy policy content is displayed
Verify microphone access and map data usage are described

title: Read the service terms
description: A visitor can review the service usage conditions on the terms page.

steps.description: Navigate to /condiciones
Verify terms content is displayed
Verify service usage conditions are described

title: Review privacy information
description: A visitor can open the privacy page and review how microphone access and report data are handled.

steps.description: Navigate to /privacidad
Verify privacy information is displayed
Verify microphone permission and report data handling information are displayed

title: Review the service conditions
description: A visitor can open the conditions page and review the usage terms for the service and map data.

steps.description: Navigate to /condiciones
Verify terms of use information is displayed
Verify map data or service usage terms are displayed

title: Sign in with valid credentials and verify authenticated profile in navbar
description: A registered citizen can sign in from /login, be redirected out of /login, and see their authenticated username and account popover with a logout button.
category: Login and logout with HttpOnly session cookies

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with valid user credentials
Fill in the password field with the matching valid password
Submit the login form by clicking Iniciar sesión
Verify the user is redirected away from /login and the authenticated username pill is visible in the navigation bar
Open the profile menu button in the header
Verify the active session details and Cerrar sesión button are displayed in the profile popover

title: Reject invalid login credentials with Spanish error feedback
description: Submitting invalid credentials on /login displays a Spanish authentication error message and keeps the visitor unauthenticated on /login.
category: Login and logout with HttpOnly session cookies

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with a username and the password field with an incorrect password
Submit the login form by clicking Iniciar sesión
Verify a Spanish error alert is displayed on /login
Verify the user remains on /login and Ingresar and Registro links remain visible

title: Sign out from an active session and revoke authentication state
description: An authenticated user can open the profile popover and click Cerrar sesión to revoke the session cookie and return to the unauthenticated header state.
category: Login and logout with HttpOnly session cookies

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Sign in with valid credentials
Verify the authenticated username pill is displayed in the header
Click the profile menu button in the header to open the account popover
Click Cerrar sesión
Verify the authenticated username pill disappears and the Ingresar and Registro links are shown again

title: Preserve report draft across /reportar -> /login -> /registro -> /reportar and submit authenticated report
description: Submitting a report draft without a session redirects to /login, preserves the draft when continuing to /registro to create a new citizen account, restores all draft fields on /reportar, and submits the report successfully.
category: Preparation and draft preservation of a noise report

steps.description: Navigate to /reportar
Search for a Huancayo location and select a suggested place
Select a noise source, enable the optional noise level toggle and set a dBA value, and enter a valid description of at least 10 characters
Click Enviar reporte while unauthenticated
Verify redirection to /login with the preserved draft notice visible
Click Regístrate aquí to navigate to /registro
Complete the registration form with valid personal fields, matching Junín department, province, and district, and a unique username and password, then submit
Verify redirection back to /reportar with the selected place, noise source, decibel value, and description restored
Click Enviar reporte now that the user is authenticated
Verify the report submission succeeds and displays the Reporte recibido confirmation receipt with a report code

title: Validate required fields and short description on /reportar before submission
description: The report form disables submission until a place suggestion is selected and displays field validation feedback when source or description requirements are not met.
category: Preparation and draft preservation of a noise report

steps.description: Navigate to /reportar
Verify the Enviar reporte button is disabled and the location selection hint is displayed before picking a place
Search for a Huancayo location and select a suggested place
Leave the noise source unselected, enter a description shorter than 10 characters, and click Enviar reporte
Verify field validation messages and the validation summary alert are displayed without submitting the form
